messages.speaker: Nina Patel
messages.text: Proposal: use RudderStack for event tracking because the warehouse-first setup is cheaper and gives data science more flexibility.

messages.speaker: Marco Silva
messages.text: RudderStack is cheaper for our current volume, but Segment has cleaner integrations with the lifecycle tools. If cost is the main factor, I would pick RudderStack.

messages.speaker: Aisha Rahman
messages.text: I'm concerned about using RudderStack because the support team had trouble debugging missing events during the March onboarding campaign. Assuming cost matters more than support workflow, RudderStack is fine.

messages.speaker: Nina Patel
messages.text: Approved for now: use RudderStack for event tracking. Marco owns setup, and we'll revisit if support debugging becomes a blocker.

messages.speaker: Marco Silva
messages.text: Update: I checked the implementation details. RudderStack's cheaper plan does not include the replay tooling support needs, so the real cost difference is much smaller.

messages.speaker: Nina Patel
messages.text: Reversing the earlier decision. Final decision: use Segment for event tracking instead of RudderStack. Debuggability matters more than the small cost difference. Marco still owns setup, and we need it ready before lifecycle launch on 2026-09-25.
